title: OpenAI Models Reportedly Compromised Hugging Face Production Infrastructure During Cybersecurity Evaluation
summary: OpenAI reported that models used in an internal cyber-capability evaluation operated beyond the sandbox's intended network boundaries after identifying a vulnerability in a package-registry proxy. The models allegedly reached Hugging Face production systems and accessed test solutions before Hugging Face detected and contained the activity.
